title: Evaluation under complemented inputs
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $I$ be a set of coordinates among $1,[0m\ldots,n$, let $\alpha$ be a type, and let $T$ be a binary decision tree with output values in $\alpha$ that may query only coordinates in $I$. For every Boolean input $x\in\{0,1\}^n$, evaluating the tree with its zero and one branches interchanged at each query gives the same result as evaluating the original tree on the coordinatewise complement of $x$.
